model: GMS8 80% single-stage multi-position gas furnace (GMS80403ANBB to GMS81405DNCE)
notes: Covers the 30 GMS8 models in the parts list, from 45,000 to 140,000 Btu/h input, in cabinet widths of 14 to 24.5 in. Motor, wheel, capacitor, gas valve, pressure switch and limit parts change by size, so match them to the full model code using the parts list's M-numbers (M1 = GMS80403ANBB up to M30 = GMS81405DNCE).

gaps: The parts list (RP-855C, October 2015) and the spec sheet (SS-GMS8, 9/11) are different revisions; horsepower by size agrees in every size compared (0403A to 1405D).

The igniter resistance and flame signal are IO-359J (1/11) figures for the *MS8 family. Its airflow tables name sizes 0453A to 1405D, not the parts list's 0403A to 1205D, and it does not name GMS8 outright (the G brand letter fits its *MS8 wildcard).
The parts list gives no motor voltage or amps. The spec sheet states 115 VAC, 60 Hz, single phase for every furnace, not for a motor, so no v is set on the motors.
The auxiliary limit is printed 'AUX LIMIT - LT BLUE 120' with a small raised mark and no F or C, so no unit is given.
A pressure switch setpoint is printed for B1370158 only.
M1 to M4 list 20162901 'PRESSURE LIMIT-RED' in the primary limit position; not claimed as a primary limit.

Not claimed: parts-list numbers for the igniter (20165703; 0130F00008 on M26, M28, M30) and flame sensor (0130F00010), since those lines cite the installation manual; limit temperatures; vent motor ratings; gas valve voltage.
method: Goodman RP-855C Repair Parts, GMS8* Multi-Position Furnace (October 2015, replaces RP-855B), Goodman Manufacturing Company, L.P.; pages 3, 5, 7, 9 and 11 used, page 3 also rendered as an image.
The goodmanmfg.com mobile-site copy of RP-855C is byte-identical to the supplyhouse S3 copy the researcher used, so the maker's URL is cited.

Goodman SS-GMS8 (9/11, supersedes 8/11) GMS8/GDS8/GHS8 product specifications, same mobile site; text identical to the climasmonterrey.com copy. Pages 1, 3 and 4 used for the input range and the horsepower cross-check.
Goodman IO-359J installation instructions for *M(H,S)8 / *D(H,S)8 / *HS8 / GME8 gas furnaces (1/11), goodmanmfg.com mobile site; pages 33 to 35 used.
ManualsLib and ManualMachine copies of GMS8 manuals were not used.

comps.spec: Blower motor by size: 1/3 HP, OEM 0131F00027, listed as 4SP, 6PL (GMS80403 and GMS80603, M1-M8); 1/2 HP, OEM 0131F00022, listed as 4 SP, 6 PL (GMS80604B, GMS80804B, GMS80805C and GMS81005C, M9-M24); 3/4 HP, OEM 20046618 (GMS81205D and GMS81405D, M25-M30)

Blower wheel by size, as listed: 10 X 6, OEM B1368034 (GMS80403 and GMS80603, M1-M8); 10 X 8, OEM B1368016 (GMS80604B and GMS80804B, M9-M16); 10 X 10, OEM B1368047 (GMS80805C and GMS81005C, M17-M24); 11 X 10, OEM B1368000 (GMS81205D and GMS81405D, M25-M30)
Capacitor on the blower and control panel page, by size: 12.5 MFD 370 V, OEM CAP125000370CP (M1-M8); 20 MFD 370 V, OEM CAP200000370CP (M9-M24); 25 MFD 370 V, OEM CAP250000370CP (M25-M30)
Vent motor capacitor, OEM DY6.186.070 (all models)
Transformer, 120 V to 24 V, 40 VA, OEM 0130M00140 (all models)

Gas valve: OEM 0151M00013, listed as 'GAS VALVE (HW) SINGLE STAGE', on M1, M3, M5 and so on up to M23 (the models ending BB, GMS80403 to GMS81005C); OEM 0151M00037, listed as 'GAS VALVE', on M2, M4 and so on up to M24 (the models ending BC) and on M25-M30 (all GMS81205D and GMS81405D)
Flame sensor, a probe mounted on the burner/manifold assembly; the installation manual for *MS8 furnaces (IO-359J) gives a flame sense signal of 1 to 6 microamps at 115 volts after cleaning

Pressure switch by size: OEM B1370158, listed as 'PRESSURE SWITCH -0.70" WC' (GMS80403, GMS80804B and GMS81005C, M1-M4, M13-M16, M21-M24); OEM B1370179 (GMS80603, GMS80604B and GMS80805C, M5-M12, M17-M20); OEM 0130F00042 (GMS81205D and GMS81405D, M25-M30)

Hot-surface igniter; the installation manual for *MS8 furnaces (IO-359J) says its resistance should not exceed 75 ohms, measured with the igniter and surrounding air at about 70°F and its wires not connected to other electrical components (replace the igniter if it does)
Ignition board, listed as 'HSI INTEGRATED': OEM PCBBF123S (M1-M25, M27, M29) or OEM PCBBF134 (M26, M28, M30: GMS81205DNBC, GMS81205DXBC, GMS81405DNCE)
Manual reset R.O.S. limit, OEM 10123529, listed with QTY 2 (all models)

Primary limit: OEM 20162904, listed as 'PRIMARY LIMIT-TEMPERATURE CONTROL' with a pointer to service bulletin SF-054 (GMS80603, GMS80604B, GMS80804B and GMS81005C, M5-M16, M21-M24); OEM 20162903, listed as 'PRIMARY LIMIT - BLUE' (GMS80805C, GMS81205D and GMS81405D, M17-M20, M25-M30)
Auxiliary limit, OEM 0130F00038, listed as 'AUX LIMIT - LT BLUE 120' (all models)
Cabinet parts in four widths (14, 17.5, 21 and 24.5 in.): blower access door, control access door, top and solid bottom case
